crow-water.name: crow_find
crow-water.text: 瓶子里面有水，但水太少了，喝不到

crow-water.name: crow_moral
crow-water.text: 遇事要善于动脑筋想办法

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_rabbit_fast
turtle-rabbit.text: 兔子一马当先，跑得飞快

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_sleep
turtle-rabbit.text: 这乌龟太慢了，我先睡一觉

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_tortoise_walk
turtle-rabbit.text: 乌龟一步一步，坚持不懈地向前爬

turtle-rabbit.name: turtle_wakeup
turtle-rabbit.text: 兔子醒来，发现乌龟快到终点了！

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_obstacle
foolish-move-mountain.text: 两座大山挡在家门前，怎么出门呢

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_pick
foolish-move-mountain.text: 老人拿起锄头，挖了起来

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_persist
foolish-move-mountain.text: 我挖不完，还有儿孙；子子孙孙，总有一天能把路打开

foolish-move-mountain.name: foolish_moral
foolish-move-mountain.text: 只要坚持，就没有搬不动的山
